info.title: SLOPwise legacy API
info.description: Canonical contract of the current Next.js /api/v1 API. Monetary integer fields use the application's current minor-unit convention.

get.summary: List activity from the current user's active groups
get.description: Returns a keyset-paginated account feed ordered by createdAt DESC, id DESC. Activity from groups where the current membership is inactive is excluded.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 50.

200.description: Account activity page ordered newest first

post.summary: Verify credentials for the web BFF and return session claims
post.description: Transitional BFF boundary. It creates no HTTP session and returns the same 401 response for unknown users and invalid passwords.

200.description: Verified identity claims used to create the web session

sessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
sessionCookie.description: Auth.js same-origin session cookie. Secure deployments may use the __Secure- prefixed cookie name.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Recommended for create commands. Reusing the key with the same request within 24 hours returns the original resource; a different request returns 409.

EmptyObject.description: Successful mutation with an empty JSON object

Forbidden.description: Authenticated principal is not allowed to perform the operation

NotFound.description: Resource is absent, invisible, or invite is invalid

Conflict.description: Domain conflict, duplicate registration, or exhausted Serializable retries

UnprocessableEntity.description: Zod request validation error or domain validation error

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required external exchange rate is unavailable

InternalServerError.description: Explicit JSON fallback for an unexpected service or registration error. Uncaught framework failures can still use the framework's non-contract response.

OpaqueId.description: Current persistence IDs are opaque strings (typically CUIDs).

Timestamp.description: UTC ISO timestamp serialized explicitly by the v1 response mapper.

CalendarDate.description: Strict literal business date. Timestamps are rejected.

MoneyInteger.description: Legacy persisted amount backed by a PostgreSQL integer, in the application's current minor-unit convention.

AggregateMoneyInteger.description: A computed sum of multiple persisted amounts. The current JSON runtime emits it as a JavaScript number.

LegacyErrorEnvelope.description: The v1 routes expose several incompatible error envelopes.

GroupMemberUser.description: List/create responses contain the required summary fields. Group-detail responses additionally contain all three nullable payee fields.

RequisitesRequest.description: Empty strings are trimmed and stored as null. Non-empty strings are trimmed before persistence.

password.description: Must occupy at most 72 UTF-8 bytes while the legacy credentials backend uses bcrypt.
Must occupy at most 72 UTF-8 bytes because v1 uses bcrypt. Character count alone is insufficient.
